task: Resolve Phase 1-6 backlog, offline caching, and SOC integrations
summary: Completed a comprehensive audit of the .temp/tasks.md backlog. Repaired RLS policies, 19s sequence scan issues via GIN/B-Tree indexing, and fixed the handle_new_user trigger. Additionally implemented global PWA caching (Turbopack compatible) and a robust Offline-First server action queue for the Access Control Muster Station.

resolutions.issue: SSR Hydration blocking with local storage persisters
resolutions.resolution: Use useEffect to initialize the persistQueryClient outside of the server tree render to preserve hydration.
Created a manual public/sw.js and registered it via a Client Component injected in the root layout, bypassing next-pwa.
Routed Next.js Server Actions to explicit API POST handlers (e.g. /api/access-control/muster) to make them compatible with generic HTTP offline queues.
